messages:
Maya (support): heads-up: acme ticket #2045 — they say invoice total is $1,200 but dashboard shows $1,188. attached invoice link + screenshot: https://example.com/invoice/ACME-2045 :eyes:
acme-billing: yep, invoice has an extra line called 'burst_capacity_hourly_fee' for $12.00. dashboard shows zero for that line. customer says this is unexpected after we promised reserved credits.
Maya (support): ok, can someone run a quick ledger query for account_id=acme-corp for the month window (2026-02-01..2026-02-28)? suspecting cutover/rounding but want raw rows.
Luca (data-analytics): running now. quick note: last month we changed per-hour rounding to round up on invoice generation, dashboard shows pre-round sums. could be the delta.
Priya (eng-infra): also check the hourly_pulse job schedule — we had one run at 00:00 UTC and another delayed run at 00:00:05 on 2026-02-01 for a backfill. possible duplicated small window.
Ethan (billing-ops): if it's rounding + duplicate micro-window we can justify a $12 credit. but need exact repro before issuing.
Luca (data-analytics): reproducing — SQL snippet below. running against billing_events_v2 for acme-corp.

```sql
SELECT event_time, event_type, usage_tokens, unit_price_cents, billed_amount_cents
FROM billing_events_v2
WHERE account_id = 'acme-corp'
  AND event_time >= '2026-02-01T00:00:00Z'
  AND event_time < '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z'
  AND event_type LIKE '%burst%'

ORDER BY event_time;
```

Luca (data-analytics): sample rows from query:

```
2026-02-01T00:00:00Z | burst_capacity_pulse | tokens=0 | unit_price_cents=0 | billed_amount_cents=0
2026-02-01T00:00:05Z | burst_capacity_pulse | tokens=120 | unit_price_cents=10 | billed_amount_cents=1200
... (other rows omitted)
```

Luca (data-analytics): sum(billed_amount_cents)=1200 for those burst rows => $12.00. dashboard is filtering pulses where tokens>1000 (old threshold) so it hides short pulses; invoice pipeline aggregates all pulses then applies per-line rounding.
Maya (support): ah — dashboard filter mismatch + invoice rounding. that explains missing line but why did a 5s-late pulse exist?
Priya (eng-infra): the delayed pulse is from the hourly_pulse backfill that ran during migration on 2026-02-01. it inserted additional pulses for a small range to catch missed windows. normally backfill tags 'backfill=true' but billing pipeline ignored that flag for burst pulses. this looks like the bug.
acme-billing: thanks — that's exactly it. we did run a manual backfill Feb 1 for migration. didn't think it would bill separately.
Ethan (billing-ops): proposed remediation: 1) issue a $12.00 credit for ACME invoice 2045, 2) fix billing pipeline to ignore backfill-tagged pulses for billing, 3) update dashboard filter to show lines with tokens<1000 or annotate. agree? :thumbsup:
Priya (eng-infra): agree. I'll open an infra PR to respect backfill flag and add a short window dedupe (5s tolerance) on pulse ingestion.
Luca (data-analytics): will publish an audit query and attach to ticket. also suggest changing invoice rounding to aggregate at account-level before rounding to cents to avoid micro-deltas.
Maya (support): will notify customer that we're issuing a credit and rolling a fix. ETA for credit?
Ethan (billing-ops): credit queued — should apply in 1 business day. I'll also add a note to invoice explaining 'applied credit for duplicate backfill pulses'.
acme-billing: appreciated. can you also cc finance? need this on our internal ledger.
Ethan (billing-ops): done, cc'd finance and attached audit link.
invoicing-bot: invoice-generator: generated invoice ACME-2045 at 2026-03-02T14:02:10Z, applied_adjustments=[{"type":"credit","amount_cents":1200,"reason":"duplicate backfill pulses"}]
Maya (support): closing loop — customer confirmed receipt and says explanation is fine. leaving thread open until infra change merges.
Priya (eng-infra): small follow-up: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/5423. tests added for backfill flag and 5s dedupe. will watch deploy.
Maya (support): thanks everyone — marking ticket as 'credit issued / fix in progress'.
acme-billing: thanks team :raised_hands:
